question: Paula starts from Point A and drives 5 km towards South. He then takes a right turn, drives 9 km, turns right and drives 13 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 11 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 8 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90° turns only unless specified.)
solution:
Paula starts from Point A and drives 5 km towards South.

 
• He then takes a right turn, drives 9 km, turns right and drives 13 km.
 
• He then takes a right turn and drives 11 km.
 
• He takes a final right turn, drives 8 km and stops at Point P.
